name: mcp-server-review
description: Inventory and assess an MCP server interface without invoking tools or reading resource contents.
inputs: local stdio server command OR exact remote MCP endpoint plus scope
optional bearer token supplied by environment variable
interfaces: agentsec mcp-inspect; agentsec mcp-http-inspect; agentsec analyze; MCP mcp_inventory_analyze
parallel_safety: inventory of independent servers may run in parallel. Do not concurrently launch the same stateful server unless its operator confirms that is safe.
